title: Pricing module: discount and free-shipping threshold
objective: Implement applyDiscount(totalCents, pct) and qualifiesForFreeShipping(totalCents) in src/pricing.mjs. Free shipping starts at exactly 5000 cents, inclusive. Keep only src/pricing.mjs and tests/implementer.test.mjs inside scope; never edit tests/acceptance.test.mjs.
acceptance: AC-3: pct 0 returns the total, pct 100 returns 0
AC-4: negative, fractional or out-of-range inputs throw RangeError
